rationale: The assistant immediately picked up on the sink replacement and asked exactly the right first checks (hose routing under the sink, sink drainage, timing), matching the ground-truth sensible first step. It correctly identified the missing high loop as the cause, gave safe plumbing-only instructions ('clipped up beneath the worktop'), suggested the fitter clear the slow trap, and explicitly deprioritised the pump/non-return valve rather than recommending parts. Calibration was good throughout ('less likely', 'very likely all the dishwasher itself needed'), with no invented evidence and no repetition; the fix was confirmed by the customer.
